privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This app is a study tool. Below is what data is collected, why it's needed and how you can delete it.
privacy.s1Body: If you sign in with Telegram, the bot passes on the following, and it is linked to your account:
privacy.s1i1: Your Telegram ID, first name and (if you have one) username — so we can recognise you.
privacy.s1i2: Your progress: exam results, Fehlerbuch, vocabulary review state and settings.
privacy.s1i3: Exam date and target level — if you enter them yourself.
privacy.s2Body: We never ask for an email address, phone number or password — we simply don't have them. We can't see your Telegram chats either: the bot only receives the message sent when you tap “Start”. Voice recordings from the Sprechen exercise stay on your device and are never sent to the server.
privacy.s3i1: In your browser — without an account, everything stays there and nowhere else.
privacy.s3i2: On the server (Supabase, Europe) — only if you're signed in with Telegram, so your progress syncs across devices.
privacy.s4Body: Your data is never sold to third parties and never used for advertising. Only the app server can reach the database; direct access from the browser is blocked.
privacy.s5Body: If you want your account and all data deleted, message the bot — we'll delete it. Data in your browser you can remove yourself at any time by clearing the site data.
privacy.s6Body: The app is not affiliated with the Goethe-Institut or telc and does not replace an official exam. Only the publicly known structure was adopted; all texts and tasks were written for this app.
